g.title: Entity Relationship Diagram created by erdantic

a.xlink:title:
hydromodpy.core.config_kit.persistence.PersistenceConfig
Orthogonal switch governing every persistence sink.
Toggles are independent: disabling ``save_zarr`` does not silence the catalog, and vice versa. ``save_catalog`` is the master switch for the project DuckDB; when False, every write through :class:`Catalog` becomes a no-op.

hydromodpy.simulation.planning.config.MeshProcessConfig
``[[simulation.process]]`` entry for a mesh orchestration process.

hydromodpy.simulation.planning.config.SimulationTimeConfig
Canonical simulation time window and forcing-coverage policy.

hydromodpy.simulation.planning.results_config.ResultsConfig
Configuration for ``[simulation.results]``.
Controls whether simulation outputs are stored in the Catalog and which derived variables are computed. Automated export formats live in the top-level ``[export]`` section (:class:`ExportConfig`), not here.

hydromodpy.simulation.planning.results_config.DerivedConfig
Toggle flags for derived variable computation.
There is no ``groundwater_flux`` flag: no backend stores the intercell face flows it would need. MODFLOW 6 filters FLOW-JA-FACE out of the per-cell budget (it is an antisymmetric vector record, not a scalar stress term), Boussinesq has no face record at all, and the derivation could only ever fail after the solve. The flag was removed with its computation rather than kept as a run-killing option.
